name: Lake Lyndon B Johnson
source: USGS National Hydrography Dataset (NHD) High Resolution, 'Waterbody - Large Scale' layer, https://hydro.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/nhd/MapServer/12 (public domain).
positional_accuracy_note: NHD High Resolution is compiled at 1:24,000; the National Map Accuracy Standard for that scale puts 90% of well-defined points within 40 ft (12.2 m). Coordinates here are rounded to 1e-6 degree (~0.1 m).
